origins.name: Häkke Breach Armaments
origins.description:
This weapon deals increased damage against vehicles and constructs.

Constructs include barricades, turrets, Stasis crystals, and other objects created in the field.

origins.description: When targets are nearby, final blows grant weapon damage, reload speed, and handling until the wielder's death.

perks.description: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

perks.description: Gain aim assist, stability, and flinch resistance while you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or Void Overshield.

enhanced.description: Gain lingering aim assist, stability, and flinch resistance while you have Woven Mail, Frost Armor, or Void Overshield.

perks.description: Reloading after defeating a target greatly increases target acquisition and aim down sight speed for a short duration.

enhanced.name: Tunnel Vision

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Attrition Orbs
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage creates an Orb of Power.

enhanced.name: Attrition Orbs
enhanced.description: Dealing sustained damage creates a slightly improved Orb of Power.

perks.name: Kinetic Tremors
perks.description: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets.

enhanced.name: Kinetic Tremors
enhanced.description: Sustained kinetic damage to a target emits a shockwave that damages any nearby targets. Perk activates more quickly.

perks.name: Adagio
perks.description: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for a brief time.

enhanced.name: Adagio
enhanced.description: After defeating a target, this weapon fires, charges, or draws more slowly and deals increased damage for an improved time.

perks.name: Adrenaline Junkie
perks.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon.

enhanced.name: Adrenaline Junkie
enhanced.description: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon for an improved duration.

perks.name: Precision Instrument
perks.description: Dealing sustained damage increases precision damage.

enhanced.name: Precision Instrument
enhanced.description: Dealing sustained damage significantly increases precision damage.

perks.name: Elemental Honing
perks.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

enhanced.name: Elemental Honing
enhanced.description: Dealing unique elemental damage grants this weapon a stacking damage bonus for an improved duration. This bonus is increased for kinetic weapons.

perks.name: High Ground
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

enhanced.name: High Ground
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks. Increases reload.
